market_definition: The protein-based adhesives market comprises adhesives derived from animal or plant proteins such as casein, collagen, soy and blood. It measures sales of finished adhesives for wood, paper, labelling and artisan bonding. BY SOURCE: Casein, Animal Glue (Hide / Bone), Soy Protein, Other Proteins. BY FORM: Liquid, Granules / Powder. BY END-USE INDUSTRY: Woodworking & Plywood, Bottle Labelling, Bookbinding & Paper, Musical Instruments & Restoration, Other End-Use Industries. BY REGION: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia Pacific (APAC), Middle East, Africa. EXCLUDED from the market: Starch and dextrin-based adhesives; synthetic bio-based adhesives such as bio-PU; gelatin sold for food or pharma. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR: a distributor, stockist or specialty reseller that buys these products from their makers and sells them to industrial, construction or trade customers. EXCLUDED companies: product and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms.
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER.
